from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CreditImpairmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of the credit impairment loss metric extracted from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the reporting company")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item in the document (e.g., '信用减值损失')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the credit impairment loss")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., '元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this value (e.g., '2024 Q1')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document containing the metric")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    credit_impairment_metrics: list[CreditImpairmentRecord]
